stemMd: A museum proposes replacing printed labels with a free phone application. Because printing will cease and the application already exists, the director concludes that the change will reduce annual operating costs. Which assumption does the argument require?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Printing costs have increased each year.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The application contains more information than the labels.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The new arrangement will not introduce costs exceeding the printing savings.

explanationMd: Compare total costs before and after the change. Eliminating printing saves money only if new costs do not offset that saving. Negating the keyed statement permits an overall increase, defeating the conclusion.

distractorRationale.b: Information volume does not determine annual savings.
distractorRationale.a: Savings are possible even with stable printing costs.
distractorRationale.e: Preference alone does not establish the budget effect.
distractorRationale.c: Universal ownership is unnecessary for the cost comparison.
